backup.name: mongo-data
backup.path: STRING=$(cat /etc/systemd/system/wallet.service | grep MONGO_STRING | cut -d'=' -f3- | cut -d"'" -f1); mongodump --uri=$STRING --out="$BACKUP_PATH/mongodb/mongo-data"

preRestore.name: Install mongoDb
preRestore.command: curl -fsSL https://www.mongodb.org/static/pgp/server-8.0.asc | gpg -o /usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg --dearmor; echo 'deb [ arch=amd64,arm64 signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/mongodb-server-8.0.gpg ] https://repo.mongodb.org/apt/ubuntu noble/mongodb-org/8.0 multiverse' | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/mongodb-org-8.0.list ; apt update -y; apt install -y mongodb-org

preRestore.name: Start mongod service temporarily with default config to upload backup

postRestore.name: Enable and restart mongoDb
postRestore.command: systemctl enable --now mongod.service; systemctl restart mongod.service

postRestore.name: Start and enable wallet service
postRestore.command: systemctl daemon-reload; systemctl enable --now wallet.service; systemctl restart wallet.service
